statement: Within elemental fcc metals, cross-model B0 dispersion predicts median B0 error well enough to license cross-class B0 correction or uncertainty semantics.

premises.statement: The class-stratified fcc B0 dispersion-error relationship is positive enough to support an uncertainty or cross-class correction license.

lean_theorem.reason: The observed Spearman anti-correlation is statistical evidence, not a formally proved theorem.

runtime_gate.reason: No runtime correction or uncertainty gate is licensed for fcc B0; the anti-correlation requires fail-closed descriptive treatment.

excluded_scope: bcc a0, which has a separate empirical dispersion-error license
Material classes other than elemental fcc metals
